stories.headline: SBU releases compilation video of drone strikes destroying Russian aircraft worth $1 billion
stories.summary: Ukraine's Security Service published a video compilation showing successful long-range drone strikes against five Russian military airbases in 2025, claiming destruction of 15 aircraft and over $1 billion in damage to Russian military infrastructure.

stories.summary: Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi described the situation as difficult on the Pokrovsk and Ocheretyne fronts, with Russian forces bringing up reserves and using infiltration tactics while Ukrainian forces focus on inflicting maximum losses on enemy reserves.

Ukraine also revealed details of a 20-point peace plan with the US.

stories.summary: Foreign Minister Sybiha urged continued global pressure on Russia after strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure including a maternity hospital in Zaporizhzhia. He emphasized blocking Russia's 'shadow fleet' and adopting stronger EU sanctions while securing IAEA confirmation that Russian energy attacks pose nuclear threats.

stories.summary: President Zelensky announced that a US security guarantees document is completely ready and Ukraine is waiting for partners to set a signing date after trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi. The agreement would then go to the US Congress for ratification.

stories.headline: Defense Minister Fedorov appoints tech bloggers as military advisors
stories.summary: New Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov appointed two prominent Telegram bloggers and activists as advisors on defense technology and drone warfare, saying they will help Ukraine build counter-systems for Russian drones and analyze captured enemy equipment.

articles.title: Ukraine's new 35-year-old defense minister made 2 influential Telegram bloggers his advisors for drone warfare

stories.headline: Syrskyi conducts military medical and command meetings at General Staff
stories.summary: Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi held meetings on medical priorities in the Armed Forces and with frontline commanders. He discussed development of medical battalions and recognized servicemen for courage and professionalism in combat.

articles.title: CinC Syrskyi holds meeting on medical priorities in AFU
CinC Syrskyi meets with commanders carrying out combat missions on frontline

stories.headline: Zelensky appeals for more Western air defense systems
stories.summary: President Zelensky called on Western allies to provide more air defense support as Russian strikes left hundreds of buildings in Kyiv without heating during freezing temperatures. He blamed delayed European payments for keeping Ukraine's air defenses 'simply empty.'

articles.title: Zelenskyy seeks more air defence amid harsh winter and Russian attacks
Volodymyr Zelenskyy blames European states for Ukraine air defence gaps

stories.headline: Ukraine ends diplomatic passivity toward Hungary, Sybiha announces
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Sybiha said Ukraine is ending its policy of diplomatic 'non-noticing' with Hungary and will respond decisively to unfriendly steps and anti-Ukrainian rhetoric from Hungarian leadership, including attempts to drag Kyiv into Hungary's domestic politics.

articles.title: Ukraine ends policy of diplomatic passivity with Hungary, Sybiha says

stories.headline: Ukraine prepares sanctions against Lukashenko for war complicity
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Sybiha announced Ukraine is preparing sanctions against Belarusian President Lukashenko to hold him accountable for supporting Russia's war, saying Belarus bears equal responsibility with Russia for the invasion.

articles.title: Lukashenko must be held accountable for 'complicity' in Russia's war, Sybiha says

stories.headline: Ukraine offers security cooperation to Moldova over Transnistria
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Sybiha said the threat of continued Russian military presence in Moldovan Transnistria is becoming increasingly obvious and that Kyiv is ready to consider Moldova's appeal for further practical security cooperation.

articles.title: Ukraine ready to consider Moldova's appeal for contribution to its security – Sybiha

stories.headline: Sybiha emphasizes Poland's support for Ukraine's EU membership
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Sybiha said Poland supports Ukraine's EU and NATO membership and is one of its biggest advocates, emphasizing that Ukraine's EU membership is in Poland's interest and noting progress on sensitive historical issues.

articles.title: Ukraine / Foreign Minister: Ukraine's membership in the EU is in the interest of Poles

stories.headline: Budanov appointed Head of Presidential Office
stories.summary: Kyrylo Budanov, Head of the Main Intelligence Directorate since 2020, has been appointed Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, replacing his previous role in military intelligence.

articles.title: Kyrylo Budanov appointed Head of the Office of the President of Ukraine

stories.headline: Budanov commemorates Battle of Kruty heroes
stories.summary: Head of Presidential Office Budanov honored the memory of the Heroes of the Battle near Kruty on the anniversary, emphasizing their importance as symbols of courage and resistance for modern Ukraine and calling for building a country worthy of their sacrifice.

articles.title: Budanov: Kruty tragedy became a symbol of resistance

stories.headline: Zelensky cautious on Russian bombing pause during extreme cold
stories.summary: President Zelensky said he was waiting to see whether Russia would observe a proposed pause in strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure during bitter winter cold. He noted no formal ceasefire agreement exists but indicated Ukraine would halt energy strikes if Russia did the same.

articles.title: Zelenskyy cautious on Russian bombing pause during extreme cold weather

stories.headline: National Bank cuts key policy rate to 15 percent
stories.summary: The National Bank of Ukraine lowered its key policy rate from 15.5% to 15%, with NBU Governor Andriy Pyshnyy saying the bank will continue to respond flexibly to shifts in monetary risks.

articles.title: National Bank cuts key policy rate to 15%

stories.headline: Investigation reveals Tymoshenko's alleged plot to undermine Zelensky's parliamentary majority
stories.summary: Investigation details emerged about Yulia Tymoshenko allegedly attempting to recruit deputies from Zelensky's Servant of the People party to deny the president a working majority, with the raid on her office occurring the same evening the Rada failed to approve a government reshuffle including Fedorov's appointment as defense minister.

articles.title: Who set the trap for Ukraine's 'Iron Lady'? The trail leads from her office to Zelensky's top spy.
